title: Digital Declutter & Backup: 30-Day System
method: Live web search + page-level inspection of the listings themselves (external, read-only, $0 spend). Each entry cites the live URL, the displayed price and a verbatim snippet from the page. Pages that rendered no price are recorded as NOT_READ rather than guessed.
scope_note: Category is well supplied on Gumroad (a paid cluster at $3.49-$14.99 plus a free/PWYW tier). Our planned $19.00 sits ABOVE every observed paid comparable except none, and an existing product already carries a near-identical title ('The 30-Day Digital Declutter'). Evidence supports the category's willingness to pay in the $10-$15 band, not at $19.

competitors.name: 30-Day Digital Declutter Planner (otosto)
competitors.notes: Pay-what-you-want with a $3 minimum. 30 daily micro-actions over 6 themes, PDF instant download. Closest shape to our planned 30-day plan.
competitors.quote: "30-Day Digital Declutter Planner ... $3+ ... This planner gives you one simple, 10-20 minute action to complete each day for 30 days - no apps, no cost, no overwhelm."
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Digital Minimalism: A 30-Day Reset to Reclaim Your Focus (animeop/Onyx Editions)
competitors.notes: 21-page PDF, week-by-week reset plan (Audit -> Declutter -> Rebuild -> Systemize), trigger log, app-inventory worksheet, 90-day maintenance. Highest credible price in the closest concept cluster.
competitors.quote: "What you get: A week-by-week reset plan (Audit -> Declutter -> Rebuild -> Systemize) ... Format: PDF, 21 pages, instant download. ... 21 pages"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: THE DIGITAL RESET - 30-Day Digital Detox Workbook (theedigitalreset)
competitors.notes: 30-day detox workbook with printable screen-time trackers, habit trackers, relapse recovery. Positions as 'premium'.
competitors.quote: "The Digital Reset is a premium 30-day digital detox workbook ... $9.99"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Digital Decluttering Checklist (digitalminimalist)
competitors.notes: Pay-what-you-want ($0+). 21 ratings at 4.8 stars - a real, observable demand signal for the category, at a zero price floor. Included to show the free tier we must beat on substance, not price.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Digital Detox Checklist Notion Template (Momomuse studio)
competitors.notes: Free/pay-what-you-want Notion template. Confirms the category is also served by free Notion templates, not only PDFs.
competitors.quote: "Digital Detox Checklist Notion Template $0+ ... Declutter, Refresh & Reclaim Your Digital Life"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: The Screen Free Reset - 30-Day Digital Wellness Planner (creativebuzz3)
competitors.notes: 40-page printable planner at a pay-what-you-want floor of $3.49. Shows a 40-page deliverable can still sit at the low end of this market.
competitors.quote: "The Screen Free Reset $3.49+ ... This comprehensive 40-page printable digital planner"
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

competitors.name: Digital Declutter Guide (harry davison)
competitors.notes: A $9.99 'guide' whose only stated artifact is a 9.26 KB file - i.e. the market already pays ~$10 for a very thin PDF. Useful pricing evidence, and a quality bar to beat rather than match.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)

not_read.name: The 30-Day Digital Declutter (mauricehekker)
not_read.reason: Page rendered the title only; no price in the returned content. Recorded as NOT_READ. NOTE: the title is near-identical to our planned product name - a real differentiation risk, not evidence.

demand_signals.value: 7 priced/free comparables found on Gumroad alone in one search pass
